payloadRole: Top-level payload is chk-summary.log, the G-P7 tool-check summary at the clean exact merge (one line per command with exit code, start and end). additionalPayloads are byte copies of the tool-check logs, the build, install and launch logs, the second packaged run console, proof record, Playwright report, timeline, installer hash file and the authority stdout and stderr logs (before and after the restart), and the PowerShell drivers that ran them (the recipe). One envelope keeps the PR within the 15-file cap. Not preserved byte-for-byte: the npm run electron:build log (webpack progress, size and sha256 in mainProof build) and the six PNG screenshots (sha256 in mainProof packagedRun.artifacts). Passwords never appear in these files; the authority log records hasToken=true only.
